XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Malfunction of the vehicle body’s electrical systems

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Electronics

  • Device: Body computer module

  • Fault: The vehicle exhibits a failure of the indicators, the horn, the interior lighting and the main beam headlights. Furthermore, the dipped headlights remain on until the instrument panel is switched off.

  • Faults detected by self-diagnosis:
  • P068A (Main relay - Early closure)

  • U0100 (CAN data bus, engine control unit 1 - Loss of communication)
  • U0140 (CAN data bus, Central electronic control unit, Body computer - Loss of communication)
  • U0164 (CAN data bus, air conditioning control unit - Loss of communication)
  • B10B9 (Fan control)
  • U0155 (CAN data bus, Instrument Cluster Control Unit - Loss of communication)
  • U0010 (CAN data bus, Speed Sensor - Communication error)
  • Cause: Faulty body computer module

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the body computer module and, if necessary, replace it.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: To access the BCM, the passenger-side glove box must be removed. In this case, a visual inspection of the component revealed no faults. After replacement, reprogramming must be carried out using diagnostic equipment.
